read.en: Lumentum rose 5.7% on Nov 6 to $538.59, trading $518.01–559.00. It is below the falling 5-day ($607.9), 10-day ($739.8), 30-day ($882.4) and 100-day ($854.0) and the rising 200-day ($807.7) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero and still widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($903.97), and RSI is 30, near oversold.
read.zh: Lumentum 11月6日上涨 5.7%，收于 $538.59，盘中区间 $518.01–559.00。股价位于下行的 5 日（$607.9）、10 日（$739.8）、30 日（$882.4）和 100 日均线（$854.0）以及上行的 200 日均线（$807.7）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方且差值仍在扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$903.97），RSI 为 30，接近超卖。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $528 Feb 17 low, now support, but the $559 high faded below $550. Resistance is $548–559 (Mar 6 low, $550, Nov 6 high), then $594.8–607.9 (late-July lows, Nov 5 high, 5-day). Support is $518–528 (Nov 6 low, Feb 17 low), then $504.4–507.6 and $464–465.5. A close above $559 would target $595–608; below $518, $505.
